about.title: Hesperia Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A faulty product does not care where you bought it. Somewhere along Main Street or Bear Valley Road in Hesperia, a space heater, a child's car seat, a power tool or a set of tires can give out without warning, and the person holding it ends up in an emergency room. When that happens, California law does something unusual: it generally does not ask you to prove the manufacturer was careless. Under strict liability, the question is usually whether the product had a design, manufacturing or warning defect, and whether that defect caused your injury. For a working family in San Bernardino County, that distinction matters, because few people have the means to investigate a factory line in another state or country. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. We introduce Hesperia residents to an independent product liability attorney who takes these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery. Hold on to the product, the packaging and the receipt, and let us make the introduction.

whyChoose.title: Why Hesperia Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: You Don't Have to Prove Carelessness
items.desc: California product liability usually runs on strict liability, so the focus is on whether the product was defective and caused your injury, not on whether the maker was negligent. The attorney we connect you with knows how to frame the claim that way.

items.title: More Than One Party May Answer
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors and retailers can all be held responsible for a defective product under California law. An independent attorney can sort out who belongs in the claim, including a local Hesperia store.

items.title: Free, Independent, Contingency-Based
items.desc: LawProactive charges nothing to connect you, and the attorneys in our network work on contingency. If there is no recovery, there is no attorney fee.

items.question: My brakes or tires failed on I-15 near Hesperia and I crashed. Is that a product case?
items.answer: It can be. Hesperia recorded 442 injury collisions in 2025, and some crashes trace back to a part that did not perform as designed rather than a driving error. If a component was defective, a product liability claim may run alongside any ordinary crash claim. Keep the vehicle and the failed part exactly as they are until an attorney has looked at them.

items.question: Do I need to keep the broken product?
items.answer: Yes, and this is the single most important step. The product itself is the evidence of the defect, so store it safely, do not repair it, and keep any packaging, manuals and receipts. Photographs of the item and your injuries help as well.

items.question: What if I bought the item at a store in Hesperia but it was made overseas?
items.answer: California allows claims against everyone in the chain of distribution, including the retailer that sold it to you. That means a Hesperia store can be part of the claim even if the manufacturer is hard to reach. An independent attorney can identify each responsible party and pursue them together.
